scripts.dev: concurrently "(cd backend-rs && cargo run --bin portfolio-api)" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: (cd backend-rs && cargo build --release) && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: (cd backend-rs && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings) && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run docker:up && npm run docker:logs
scripts.test: (cd backend-rs && cargo test --workspace) && npm run test:unit --prefix frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
